name: Create a relay
description: Create a relay Provisions a new MoQ relay instance. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/moq/relays
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/moq/relays
Provisions a new MoQ relay instance. Auto-creates a publish+subscribe token and a subscribe-only token. Token values are included in the response (shown once). Config is always set to defaults (upstreams off) and cannot be supplied here — sending a non-empty `config` is rejected (21014); `null` or `{}` is accepted as absent. Use PUT to configure the relay after it exists.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account identifier.; body (body)

name: Delete a relay
description: Delete a relay Soft-deletes a MoQ relay. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/moq/relays/{relay_id}

name: Get a relay
description: Get a relay Retrieves a single MoQ relay including config and status. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/moq/relays/{relay_id}

name: List relays
description: List relays Lists all MoQ relays for the account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/moq/relays
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/moq/relays
Lists all MoQ relays for the account. Returns only metadata. Config, status, and tokens are omitted. Results are cursor-paginated (keyset on the `created` timestamp). Use `created_before` / `created_after` with the `created` value of the first/last item in a page to fetch the adjacent page. `result_info` reports the page `count` and the `total` matching the cursor filters.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account identifier.
Optional: created_before (query) — Cursor for pagination. Returns relays created strictly before this RFC 3339 timestamp (typically the `created` value of the first item on the current page, to fetch the previous page).; created_after (query) — Cursor for pagination. Returns relays created strictly after this RFC 3339 timestamp (typically the `created` value of the last item on the current page, to fetch the next page).; per_page (query) — Maximum number of relays to return per page. Values above the maximum are clamped to it rather than rejected.; asc (query) — Sort order by `created`. When true, results are returned oldest-first (ascending); otherwise newest-first (descending, the default).

name: Create a token
description: Create a token Mints a new relay-scoped token and adds it to the relay's accepted-auth registry. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/moq/relays/{relay_id}/tokens
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/moq/relays/{relay_id}/tokens
Mints a new relay-scoped token and adds it to the relay's accepted-auth registry. The token value (secret) is shown once in the response. A relay may hold up to 10 tokens; creating an 11th is rejected.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account identifier.; relay_id (path) — Relay unique identifier (32 hex characters).; body (body)

name: Revoke a token
description: Revoke a token Revokes a token by removing it from the set the relay accepts. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/moq/relays/{relay_id}/tokens/{jti}

name: List tokens
description: List tokens Returns metadata for every token the relay accepts. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/moq/relays/{relay_id}/tokens
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/moq/relays/{relay_id}/tokens
Returns metadata for every token the relay accepts. Secrets are never returned, so a token that has been lost cannot be recovered here. There is no expiry filter: compare each token's `expires` to the current time to tell which ones have lapsed.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account identifier.; relay_id (path) — Relay unique identifier (32 hex characters).

name: Update a relay
description: Update a relay Updates a relay's name and/or configuration. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/moq/relays/{relay_id}
